## Migrator.run() method

Apply every migration that has not run yet.

**Signature:**

```typescript
run(): Promise<string[]>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;string\[\]&gt;

Names of the migrations applied, empty if nothing was pending.

## Exceptions

Error if a migration file has no default export, is missing, or its `up` throws. Migrations applied before the failure stay applied and recorded.

## Remarks

All of them share one batch number, so a later `migrate:rollback` reverses exactly this run. Creates the tracking table on first use.
